structural_change: COLLECT10/COL-ISS 10-21: r128v11/v11b --cts gates FAILED clock_rule only (pin-flop spread TT/FF 86.8/92.4 and 85.1/86.0; setup WNS +0.9/+4.2 ps, hold +33/+18, GRT ovf 0, census PASS max 32). CLASS clock-tree topology (not depth/fanout/wire): per-flop CTS dump (4_1_cts, placement RC) shows every leaf internally <= 4 ps but leaf arrival rising with distance from the S x100 entry: y 0..80 ~415 ps, y 160..280 ~450-487, y 400 up to 504 (W uop_d1 column 408..485). The count-bisection spine puts nodes at count-weighted centroids (unequal wire per branch) and equalises with pad CELLS on the RC-calibrated wire model; wire-dominated far branches then come out late on the platform RC and worse at FF (cells speed up more than wire: FF spread > TT). FIX (kit only): OT_SPINE_SYM=1 = symmetric bisection with nodes at the bbox centre of their leaves (equal wire span per child, short levels merged), so the wire is balanced by construction and the pads only trim residual cell imbalance; RTL/outline/macros/pins unchanged vs hcoll_issuer_r128v11b. 0 added cycles. Predecessor: COLLECT10/ISS2 10-21: the r128v10/v10b --cts gates FAILED (both) only because the PRE-GATE NATIVE CENSUS refused the mapped netlist (floorplan.tcl PRE_GATE_NATIVE_CENSUS_REFUSED; textbook/floorplan FAILs are downstream of that abort, no geometry error): 1 violation u_ot_pr_core.u.fwn_c[0] QN -> 34 loads (limit 32), the CN counter-forwarding select of 16 low counter bits merged into the take compare. FIX (RTL, 0 cycles, port/edge-identical): fwt_c/fwn_c widened from 2 to 4 KEPT copies, each selecting 8 counter bits (~17 loads); reset group rcp[5] 24 -> 28 loads. Geometry unchanged. Predecessor: COLLECT10/ISS 10-21 SAFE successor after the FAILED route hcoll_issuer_r128v9b-r128v9b-e4c085f25 (TT -135.42 / FF -20.25, DRC 0). CLASS (routed 6_finish + closed-loop path_summary): LOGIC DEPTH behind a macro read, not fanout / wire / clock: all 64 TT-violating D pins are g_meta[*].u_sram/rd_out -> rt/rn/pr_t/pr_n/pr_c (15-16 levels): 326 ps SRAM clk->q + the record's 32-bit count-1 DECREMENT borrow chain (AND2-AO21-OR5-OR4-OR5-OR5-OR5-OR3-OR2-OR4-XNOR-...) ~540 ps in the same edge; launch clock 33 ps late (spine). FIX (RTL, 0 cycles, port- and edge-identical): records store the RAW count; the decrement is folded into the loop decision on the registered side (take = has && q + ~cnt + 2 < 2^32, carry-save + one carry-out), removing ~10 levels from every macro->state path. FF hold -20 (fv_c->r_ce_in, aen->assemble, vm->data, <=6 levels) = route hold repair residue: hold_eco mm session + io_hold_margin 0.03 kept. Geometry: v9b geometry 302.4 x 432 (clock spine, W-centre entry) unchanged (FALLBACK).
